desc: The Trump Rifle is a beautiful custom AR-15 rifle that pays tribute to the office of the 45th President of the United States of America. This stunning firearm features intricate and detailed deep-engraving on both sides, depicting various symbols, including the famous "Make America Great Again". With its exceptional attention to detail and bold visual design, the Trump Rifle is a true masterpiece that any patriotic enthusiast or collector would be proud to own.
